mission: Single Native Motion Graphics UI + First-Run Default + 196 Block Census
owner_baseline_explanation: In prior waves, frontend/src/utils/catalogOriginals.js had DONOR_INTERNALIZED_IDS hardcoded to only 10 slugs (aurora, data-chart, flowing-gradient, holographic, instagram-follow, plasma, stripes, tiktok-follow, weight-wave, yt-lower-third), and StudioResourcePanel.jsx / MotionGraphics.jsx strictly aborted preview triggering for any block outside that 10-item set. The live backend had 149 shipped blocks on disk, all of which successfully generate valid standalone preview HTML. Wave 18 Agent 2 has unblocked all 149 operable blocks in the frontend catalog while truthfully marking the remaining 47 unported blocks as STAGE2_AWAITING_PORT.
